winner.text: Add impression-time request-context features tab, hourmin, and weekday to the neutral user/item additive scaffold while leaving the model and pointwise BCE training unchanged.
winner.rationale: This directly tests the only feature family with positive measured screening evidence and full coverage.
winner.exact_ablation: Ablate the request-context feature group: compare the seed's user/item IDs alone against user/item IDs plus tab, hourmin, and weekday.

expected_effect.GAUC: Expected modest increase of about 0.001 to 0.004, with potentially stronger gains for cold users; the internal lift was +0.00221.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Expected small increase of about 0.000 to 0.003; top-five concentration may lag GAUC because cold-user nDCG@5 was 0.492 versus 0.508 for warm users/items.

selection_rationale: Select c01 because it is the only candidate backed by a positive measured screening result: request-context features produced a +0.00221 primary lift with full coverage. It offers the strongest expected reliability, low leakage and runtime risk, a clean one-group ablation, and the Consultant's highest head-to-head utility score (0.91).
